name: Zumbi Shooter: Arcade Waves
summary:

💥 Step into a fast-paced VR arcade zombie shooter built for pure adrenaline! Fight through relentless waves of the undead using dual-wield weapons, lightning-fast reflexes, and smart positioning to survive as long as possible 💥
